All verification passes post-commit. Here is the complete report.

## Repaired findings (exact seven, no scope widening)

**1. Fail-closed scalar admission** — `parse_request` now runs `_scalar_admission_violation` before any request construction: type/enum/format/bounded-value checks for idempotency key, correlation id, actor id/role, evidence reference, runbook, target strings/revision, plan id/revision/hash, decision id/hash/policy, catalog version/digest, supersession key and readback values. `plan_revision` rejects `bool` (`True` is `int` in Python); the reproduced numeric-idempotency-key case returns `SCHEMA_REJECTED`. 46 adversarial type mutations assert denial with zero state/evidence/idempotency/audit change.

**2. Exact actual-target readback** — success and rollback verification now compare the full tuple `(environment, kind, id, revision, health)`. `synthetic:wrong-service` plus wrong-environment/kind/revision seeded stores fail closed before consumption (`SCOPE_EXPANSION_REJECTED` / `TARGET_REVISION_CONFLICT`). The success receipt derives `target` from the verified fresh readback, never module constants.

**3. Genuine current-authority sources** — new closed in-memory `CurrentAuthorityStore`/`CurrentAuthoritySnapshot`/`CurrentObservation` read fresh inside the critical section. Revalidates current plan/decision (class, expiry, closed C3 `execution_authorized:false`/`actuator_gate:closed`/`current_state:review_required`), immutable catalog entry, actor/role/expiry, reviewer/role/expiry/separation, and observation ids/digests/timestamps. Denies catalog replacement, plan/decision drift and supersession, role loss, actor/reviewer expiry, reviewer separation loss, observation drift/replacement/staleness, and missing current records — all stable denials, zero simulated effect.

**4. Effect audit only on verified success** — `_rollback_path` restores the effect-audit snapshot; every transition/audit/readback/rollback failure path now leaves zero retained effect records, while the monotone attempt audit and consumed evidence remain. Evidence shows all denial/rollback cases `effect_record_count: 0`; success `1`.

**5. Exact counter-property schemas** — both receipt schemas enumerate/require all 18 named zero-capability counters with `additionalProperties:false` and `const:0`. Schema mutations (rename to `arbitrary_0..17`, omit each name, add an extra name, non-zero) all reject.

**6. Non-caller-selectable entropy** — `EvidenceIssuer.mint` no longer accepts `reference`/`nonce`; production always calls module `_generate_reference()`/`_generate_nonce()` (`secrets.token_hex`). Deterministic acceptance patches only inside `_with_fixed_entropy`. Tests prove the signature has no such params and two unpatched issuances differ.

**7. Concurrency-safe issuance** — the complete `(plan_revision, supersession_key)` check-and-insert is under an issuer-owned lock. 8-thread barrier test: exactly one mint succeeds, seven get `STALE_OR_SUPERSEDED`, exactly one record and one issued key.
